en.commentary:
I rank water heaters around the day you will actually buy one, and for most households that is the day the old one fails. That single fact sets my top recommendation: replace a tank past ten years old on a weekday morning of your own choosing. Emergency dispatch carries a 25 to 50 percent premium on labor, and on a standard 50 gallon swap that works out to roughly $300 to $1,000 of pure timing penalty. Same day replacement runs $1,500 to $3,500, while a planned job sits closer to the $1,347 national average. The pages that rank highest for this search belong to plumbing companies whose revenue comes from that 2 a.m. call, so I will say the cheap version out loud.

The second thing that moved this year is federal money. Section 25C expired on December 31, 2025 under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act signed on July 4, 2025, with no transition period. Heat pump water heaters carried the highest cap in that program, 30 percent of project cost up to $2,000. Work completed through the end of 2025 remains claimable. Anything installed in 2026 pays full freight, which pulls gas tanks back into contention for households that were on the fence. HEEHRA point of sale rebates still operate in the states that launched them, so check your state energy office before you write off the incentive entirely.

Prices climbed on top of that. A.O. Smith raised water heater prices 7 percent effective June 22, 2026, citing steel running about 15 percent above 2025 levels and Section 301 tariff exposure.

Third, know who built the thing. A.O. Smith owns State, American, Reliance and U.S. Craftmaster and also owns Lochinvar. Rheem owns Ruud, Richmond, EcoSense, Eemax and EcoSmart. Bradford White builds under its own name and sells through licensed plumbers. While researching this I hit two published brand charts that disagreed about who builds State and American, which is a fair measure of how much the retail label tells you. Buy the label the manufacturer signs.

highlights.title: Replacing early is worth $300 to $1,000, and every plumbing site has a reason to stay quiet about it
highlights.body: Emergency dispatch adds 25 to 50 percent to labor rates, and same day replacement of a standard 50 gallon tank runs $1,500 to $3,500 against a planned national average around $1,347. Weekday business hours land at $1,200 to $2,500, weekends at $1,500 to $3,200, and a holiday or after midnight call starts at $1,800. Those spreads are the whole argument. A water heater in its eleventh year is a scheduling decision you still control, and the moment it lets go you are paying whatever the first available truck charges. I would rather you spend a Tuesday morning on this than a Sunday night.

highlights.title: The Rheem ProTerra takes first place for what it does at the moment the tank gives out
highlights.body: Water heater failure is a leading source of indoor water damage, average claims run around $4,444, and about 69 percent of failures show up as a slow leak or a burst tank. On units past ten years old, 60 to 70 percent of failures come with visible water. The ProTerra ships with a leak sensor and automatic water shutoff as standard equipment on a 10 year warranty, in the cheapest widely stocked hybrid on the market at $1,500 to $2,100. A.O. Smith matches that feature set on the Signature 900 for a few hundred dollars more. Both of those beat paying for a hardwood floor.

highlights.title: Bradford White earns its premium by keeping its name off everyone else's product
highlights.body: A.O. Smith and Rheem both run large private label operations, which is why the GE and Kenmore units on a retail floor trace back to one of them and why published ownership charts contradict each other on the details. Bradford White sells only Bradford White, only through licensed plumbers and wholesale supply houses. That policy is the reason a Bradford White model number resolves cleanly to one factory, one spec sheet and one warranty. The AeroTherm RE2H50 carries a Vitraglas lining with a Microban additive and efficiency up to 3.1 EF, and the Defender gas tank is what your plumber already keeps on the truck.

highlights.title: With 25C dead, a gas tank is the honest answer for a lot of households in 2026
highlights.body: A heat pump water heater used to arrive with up to $2,000 of federal money behind it, which closed the gap against a $900 gas tank almost entirely. That credit expired on December 31, 2025 with no phase out. Today the Rheem Performance Platinum gas tank installs for $900 to $1,200 in the box, drops into the same footprint and vent as the unit you are pulling, and a plumber can source one the same morning. If your utility still runs an electrification rebate the hybrid math holds. If it does not, and your electric rate is high, I rank the gas tank fourth on this list for a reason.

highlights.title: EcoSmart ECO 27 is a Rheem product, and it needs a service upgrade most homes will not do
highlights.body: Rheem acquired Eemax in December 2015, and EcoSmart sits in the same portfolio, so the $330 tankless on Amazon and the $2,000 ProTerra come from the same parent company. The price gap is real, and so is the reason for it. A 27 kilowatt unit at 240 volts pulls about 112 amps, which means three double pole 40 amp breakers and, in practice, a 150 amp or larger service with panel space to spare. Add $1,500 to $4,000 for a panel upgrade and the cheapest unit on this list stops being cheap. It earns its place at the bottom on retrofit difficulty alone.

zh-tw.commentary:
熱水器這題我的排序邏輯很直接，你要在它還會動的時候把它換掉。

美國急件更換的工錢比預約多收 25% 到 50%，一台標準 50 加侖的更換換算下來要多付 300 到 1,000 美元，大概就是一萬到三萬台幣，這筆錢純粹是買一個今天就有熱水。同一件工程排時間做，全美均價落在 1,347 美元，當天急件則是 1,500 到 3,500 美元。

老實說，這個關鍵字搜尋結果前幾名幾乎都是水電行自己經營的部落格，他們的營收就靠那通半夜打進來的電話，所以提前換比較便宜這句話，由我來講比較合適。

第二件今年變動最大的事是補助。美國聯邦的 25C 抵稅額在 2025 年 12 月 31 日到期，法源是 2025 年 7 月 4 日簽署的 One Big Beautiful Bill Act，完全沒有過渡條款。熱泵熱水器原本可以抵工程款的 30%、上限 2,000 美元，是整個方案裡額度最高的一級。2025 年底前完工的安裝還能申報，2026 年裝的就是付原價，這讓瓦斯儲熱式在原本猶豫的家庭那邊重新變得有競爭力。HEEHRA 的銷售點折抵在有開辦的州仍然運作，決定之前先查一下你所在州的能源辦公室。

價格本身也在漲。A.O. Smith 自 2026 年 6 月 22 日起全線調漲 7%，理由是鋼材比 2025 年貴了大約 15%，再加上 Section 301 關稅。

第三件事，先搞清楚這台機器到底是誰做的。A.O. Smith 旗下有 State、American、Reliance 與 U.S. Craftmaster，另外還有 Lochinvar。Rheem 旗下有 Ruud、Richmond、EcoSense、Eemax 跟 EcoSmart。Bradford White 只掛自己的名字，只透過持照水電與批發商賣。我查資料的時候撞到兩份互相矛盾的品牌歸屬表，光是 State 跟 American 歸誰就寫得不一樣，這件事本身就說明了零售標籤能給你多少資訊。買原廠自己簽名的那張標籤。

最後給台灣讀者一句話，這份榜單看的是美規機型。台灣家庭主流仍然是瓦斯即熱式，林內在兩邊市場都是主力品牌，榜上那幾台熱泵桶在台灣沒有官方代理，價格欄位是換算後的估值。

highlights.title: 提前換值一萬到三萬台幣，而每一家水電行的部落格都有理由不告訴你
highlights.body: 急件出勤的工錢會往上加 25% 到 50%，標準 50 加侖當天換是 1,500 到 3,500 美元，排時間做的全美均價則在 1,347 美元左右。平日上班時段 1,200 到 2,500 美元，週末 1,500 到 3,200 美元，遇到假日或半夜叫人 1,800 美元起跳。這個價差就是全部的論點。用到第 11 年的熱水器，換機時間還握在你手上，等它自己爆掉那天，你就只能付第一台趕到的車開出來的價錢。我會建議你花一個平日早上處理這件事，週日晚上處理的版本貴很多。

highlights.title: Rheem ProTerra 拿第一，靠的是水桶破掉那一刻它做了什麼
highlights.body: 熱水器故障是室內水損的主要來源之一，每件理賠均值大約 4,444 美元，約 69% 的故障是慢漏或爆裂，用超過十年的機組出事時有 60% 到 70% 伴隨明顯漏水。ProTerra 標配漏水感測與自動斷水，保固 10 年，而它同時是市面上常態備貨的熱泵機裡最便宜的一台，1,500 到 2,100 美元。A.O. Smith 的 Signature 900 有同一組功能，多花幾百美元。這兩台的價差，怎麼算都比重鋪一次木地板划算。

highlights.title: Bradford White 貴得有道理，因為它不幫別人做貼牌
highlights.body: A.O. Smith 跟 Rheem 都有龐大的貼牌代工業務，所以你在零售賣場看到的 GE 與 Kenmore 機型追根究柢都出自這兩家，網路上流傳的品牌歸屬表也才會互相打架。Bradford White 只賣 Bradford White，只走持照水電與批發材料行。這個政策帶來的好處很具體，一組 Bradford White 型號可以乾淨地對應到一座工廠、一份規格表、一份保固條款。AeroTherm RE2H50 用的是加了 Microban 添加劑的 Vitraglas 玻璃襯裡內膽，能效最高 3.1 EF，而 Defender 瓦斯桶就是你家師傅車上本來就有的那台。

highlights.title: 25C 抵稅額消失之後，2026 年瓦斯儲熱式對很多家庭是誠實的答案
highlights.body: 熱泵熱水器過去背後有最高 2,000 美元的聯邦補助，這幾乎完全填平了它跟一台 900 美元瓦斯桶之間的價差。那筆抵稅額在 2025 年 12 月 31 日直接結束，沒有遞減期。現在 Rheem Performance Platinum 瓦斯桶裸機 900 到 1,200 美元，可以沿用你拆掉那台的擺放位置與排氣管，師傅當天早上就調得到貨。如果你家電力公司還有電氣化補助，熱泵的帳仍然算得過去。如果沒有而且電價又高，那我把瓦斯桶排在第四是有原因的。

highlights.title: EcoSmart ECO 27 是 Rheem 的產品，而它要的電力升級大多數家庭不會做
highlights.body: Rheem 在 2015 年 12 月併購 Eemax，EcoSmart 在同一個集團裡，所以 Amazon 上那台 330 美元的即熱機跟 2,000 美元的 ProTerra 出自同一家母公司。價差是真的，價差的理由也是真的。27 千瓦的機器在 240 伏特下電流大約 112 安培，代表要拉三組 40 安培雙極斷路器，實務上需要 150 安培以上的總電源而且配電箱還要有空位。加上 1,500 到 4,000 美元的配電箱升級，全榜最便宜的那台就不便宜了。它排最後一名，光是安裝難度這一項就足夠。

en.commentary: The Rheem ProTerra Hybrid Electric 50 Gal holds first at 9.1 and heat pump water heating is the technology worth understanding here. A hybrid unit moves heat from the surrounding air into the tank instead of generating it with a resistance element, and the efficiency difference is roughly threefold. Across a fifteen year service life that is a very large sum, and it is why I weight running cost so heavily in this category. Rheem also has the deepest service network of any manufacturer here, which matters enormously for an appliance that will need a technician at some point. A water heater that nobody local can service turns a routine repair into an emergency replacement. AO Smith Signature 900 Smart Hybrid at 8.9 is very close with excellent leak detection that shuts off the supply automatically. Bradford White AeroTherm RE2H50 at 8.8 is sold through professional installers and built accordingly. Rheem Performance Platinum Gas at 8.7 is the gas option for anyone with existing gas service and no space for a heat pump. Rinnai SENSEI RSC199iN at 8.5 is the tankless choice with genuinely endless hot water. Guidance: heat pump units need adequate air volume around them and they cool the space they sit in, which suits a garage and works poorly in a small sealed closet.

highlights.title: Heat pump efficiency is roughly threefold over resistance
highlights.body: Moving heat out of the surrounding air cuts running cost dramatically against generating it electrically, and across fifteen years that difference is a very large sum. It is the single strongest argument in this category.

highlights.title: Heat pump units need air volume and cool the room
highlights.body: These work by extracting heat from the surrounding space, so a garage or utility room suits them and a small sealed closet does not. Check the manufacturer air volume requirement before committing to a location.

highlights.title: Service network availability decides a repair or a replacement
highlights.body: A water heater will need a technician at some point in fifteen years, and one nobody local can service becomes an emergency replacement. Rheem has the deepest coverage here, which is worth real weight.

highlights.title: Automatic leak shutoff prevents the expensive failure
highlights.body: A tank failure floods whatever is below it, and that damage costs far more than the heater. AO Smith detects a leak and closes the supply automatically, which turns a disaster into an inconvenience.

zh-tw.commentary:
Rheem ProTerra 混合式電熱水器 50 加侖守第一，9.1 分，而熱泵熱水這個技術值得先理解。

混合式機組是把周圍空氣中的熱搬進水槽，效率大約是電熱元件直接加熱的三倍。以十五年的服役期來算，這是一筆非常可觀的金額，也是我在這個類別把運轉成本權重拉這麼高的原因。

Rheem 的維修服務網也是這裡最深的，對一台總有一天需要技師的設備來說，這件事影響巨大。一台在地沒人修得動的熱水器，會把一次例行維修變成緊急更換。

AO Smith Signature 900 Smart Hybrid 的 8.9 咬得很近，漏水偵測很優秀，會自動關閉進水。Bradford White AeroTherm RE2H50 的 8.8 走專業安裝通路，用料也照這個標準。Rheem Performance Platinum 瓦斯款的 8.7 適合已經有瓦斯管線又沒空間放熱泵的人。Rinnai SENSEI RSC199iN 的 8.5 是瞬熱式選擇，熱水真的用不完。

建議，熱泵機組周圍需要足夠的空氣量，而且會讓它所在的空間變冷，適合車庫，放在密閉小儲藏間就不理想。

highlights.title: 熱泵的效率大約是電熱的三倍
highlights.body: 從周圍空氣把熱搬進來，運轉成本相對電熱直接加熱大幅下降，十五年累積起來是一筆很可觀的金額。這是這個類別最強的單一論點。

highlights.title: 熱泵需要空氣量，而且會讓房間變冷
highlights.body: 它的原理就是從周圍空間抽熱，所以車庫或工作間適合它，密閉小儲藏間不適合。決定安裝位置之前，先確認原廠標示的空氣量需求。

highlights.title: 維修服務網決定你是修理還是換新
highlights.body: 一台熱水器在十五年裡總會需要技師，而在地沒人修得動的那台，就只能整台換掉。Rheem 的覆蓋是這裡最深的，這值得實在的權重。

highlights.title: 自動斷水解掉了最貴的那種故障
highlights.body: 水槽破裂會淹掉它下方的一切，而那個損失遠高於熱水器本身。AO Smith 偵測到漏水就自動關閉進水，把災難降級成不方便。

en.commentary: The Rheem ProTerra Hybrid 50 holds first at 9.1 because heat pump water heating is roughly three times as efficient as resistance heating, and over a fifteen-year service life that difference dwarfs the purchase price gap. A heat pump moves heat instead of generating it, which is why the efficiency numbers look implausible until you understand the mechanism. Rheem rates its units to keep operating down to about 37 degrees Fahrenheit, and below that a hybrid switches to its resistance elements and behaves like a conventional electric tank. Field data puts the cold climate penalty at roughly 10 to 20 percent of the savings you would see in a mild climate, which still leaves a household several hundred dollars a year ahead of a standard electric tank.

Put the tank in a conditioned basement, a utility room or a laundry room with about 700 cubic feet of air around it, and keep a foot of clearance at the sides for airflow. The lesson for US buyers is that a heat pump water heater is a storage device as much as a heater. The Rheem ProTerra at 9.1 connects through Rheem's EcoNet app with vacation mode and scheduling. The A. O. Smith Signature 900 Smart Hybrid at 8.9 offers app control and leak alerts. My advice for solar owners: set the heat pump to run its main heating cycle in the late morning and early afternoon. You store the midday sunshine as hot water for the evening shower.

en.commentary:
No manufacturer announcement, recall or price move this week gives me a reason to touch this ranking, and I want to be upfront about that instead of dressing up routine market noise as news. The one regulatory item worth flagging is a Department of Energy requirement, effective October 6, that mandates condensing technology on commercial water heaters, projected to save roughly $140 million a year in energy costs nationally. That rule targets commercial units, leaving the residential tanks and tankless heaters on this page outside its scope, so it does not change a single score here, but it is a preview of where efficiency mandates are headed once the current rollback pressure eases.

What has not changed is the argument that put the Rheem ProTerra Hybrid in first place months ago. Heat pump water heating moves existing heat instead of generating it with a resistance element, and that mechanism produces roughly three times the efficiency of a standard electric tank. Over a fifteen year service life that gap compounds into real money, and it is the single biggest lever in this category regardless of what else is happening in Washington. The ProTerra backs that efficiency with a leak sensor and automatic shutoff as standard equipment, which matters because water heater failure is a leading cause of indoor water damage with average claims running over four thousand dollars.

A.O. Smith's Signature 900 Hybrid holds second with a nearly identical efficiency story and slightly different warranty terms. Bradford White's AeroTherm stays third because it sells exclusively through licensed plumbers, which keeps installation quality consistent in a way a big box purchase cannot guarantee. My advice remains the same as it has been for weeks: replace a tank past ten years old on your own schedule, because the gap between a planned Tuesday morning appointment and an emergency weekend dispatch is still $300 to $1,000 in pure timing penalty, and that math has not moved either.

The ProTerra Hybrid Electric 50 Gal keeps first place, and a 2026 heat pump water heater roundup I read this week names the Rheem ProTerra 50-gallon as a best overall pick for its 4.0 UEF rating, intuitive app controls with leak alerts, and a smooth switch to backup elements during demand peaks. Those three traits are the reasons it leads my list, so seeing them called out independently strengthens my confidence.

UEF matters because it is the efficiency number that tells you how much hot water you get per unit of energy. A 4.0 rating means the heat pump is doing most of the work, and over years of daily showers that adds up to real savings on the power bill. Signature 900 Smart Hybrid at second and AeroTherm RE2H50 at third follow the same hybrid logic, and Performance Platinum natural gas at fourth remains the sensible choice for homes already piped for gas.

The same roundup highlights other 2026 picks, including the Rinnai REHP80 for large families and models with quiet operation near 49.5 dB. I did not verify tax credit or rebate details in a source I could cite, so check your utility and state programs directly before counting on any incentive.

My install advice is to confirm the space. Heat pump units need airflow and a spot where cool exhaust is welcome, like a garage or basement. No ranking changes today.
